body.name: Projector-and-row-sum recovery map
body.construction: For each cohort \(d\), calculate \(g^d\), \(\rho_j^d\), \(P_j^d\), \(B_a^d=[P_1^dm_a^d,P_2^dm_a^d]\), \(F_y^d=(B_a^d)^{-1}A_{ay}^d\), \(q_{ay}^d=F_y^d\mathbf 1_3\), \(C_y^d=\operatorname{diag}(q_{ay}^d)^{-1}F_y^d\), \(W^d=A_{ba}^d(C_a^d)^\top\{C_a^d(C_a^d)^\top\}^{-1}\), \(c^d=(W^d)^{-1}m_b^d\), and \(B_b^d=W^d\operatorname{diag}(c^d)\). Fill \(\widehat Q_j^d\) from \(q_{ay}^d\), \((B_b^d)^{-1}A_{by}^d\mathbf 1_3\), stochastic exit residuals, and the absorbing row; fill \(\widehat R_j^d\) from the rows of \(C_y^d\) and the absorbing row. Set \(\widehat\pi_j^d=\sum_u(B_a^d[u,j]+B_b^d[u,j])\), \(\widehat p_{2,j}^d=(\widehat\pi_j^d)^{-1}(\sum_uB_a^d[u,j],\sum_uB_b^d[u,j],0)\widehat Q_j^d\), and order by \(\rho_1^d>\rho_2^d\). Finally, \(\Phi(p)=((\widehat p_{2,1}^1(\widehat R_1^1-\widehat R_1^0))^\top,(\widehat p_{2,2}^1(\widehat R_2^1-\widehat R_2^0))^\top,(\sum_j\widehat\pi_j^1\widehat p_{2,j}^1(\widehat R_j^1-\widehat R_j^0))^\top)^\top\).
